mapper.sql: CASE WHEN f.feature_code IN ('GEO_ATTENDANCE','STUDENT_LOCATION_TRACK') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS enable_allowed

FROM sys_feature_toggle_change c JOIN sys_system_task t ON t.id=c.task_id JOIN sys_feature_toggle f ON f.feature_code=c.feature_code AND f.scope_key='GLOBAL' LEFT JOIN sys_user us ON us.id=t.submitted_by LEFT JOIN sys_user ur ON ur.id=t.reviewed_by

c.id,c.task_id,c.feature_code,c.before_status,c.target_status,c.base_version,f.feature_name, f.status AS current_status,f.version_no,t.status AS task_status,t.task_title,t.task_description, CASE WHEN t.submitted_by IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(us.display_name,'未知用户') END AS submitted_by,t.submitted_by AS submitted_by_user_id,t.submitted_at, CASE WHEN t.reviewed_by IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(ur.display_name,'未知用户') END AS reviewed_by,t.reviewed_at, t.review_comment,c.created_at,
mapper.select: SELECT f.id,f.feature_code,f.feature_name,f.status,f.version_no,f.description, FROM sys_feature_toggle f WHERE f.scope_key='GLOBAL' ORDER BY f.id
SELECT ORDER BY c.created_at DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
